#include <iostream>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <tuple>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

struct Key {
    int n, h;
    bool operator==(const Key &other) const {
        return n == other.n && h == other.h;
    }
};

struct KeyHash {
    size_t operator()(const Key &k) const {
        return hash<int>()(k.n) ^ (hash<int>()(k.h) << 1);
    }
};

long long go(int n, int h, unordered_map<Key, long long, KeyHash> &v) {
    Key key = {n, h};
    auto it = v.find(key);
    if (it != v.end()) {
        return it->second;
    }
    long long result;
    if (n == 0) {
        result = 1;
    } else {
        long long sum_val = 0;
        if (h > 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                sum_val += go(i, h - 1, v) * go(n - 1 - i, h - 1, v);
            }
            result = sum_val;
        } else {
            result = 0;
        }
    }
    v[key] = result;
    return result;
}

int main() {
    int n, h;
    cin >> n >> h;
    unordered_map<Key, long long, KeyHash> v;
    cout << go(n, n, v) - go(n, max(0, h - 1), v) << endl;
    return 0;
}
